claim_tested: Acceptor-pocket Trp residues of GT6 are functionally required
key_finding: W249G raises acceptor Km; W314Y lowers kcat; W356T reduces activity
confidence_limitations: High for bovine; transfer to human A3GALT2 is by alignment

claim_tested: Glu317 is the catalytic residue of GT6
confidence_limitations: High; defines the position audited as human Glu291

key_finding: Loop ordering on donor binding; both residues contact UDP

claim_tested: Arg202-Asp316 and His315-Ser318 form the conserved donor region
key_finding: Salt bridge and conserved donor-region residues identified

claim_tested: DVD motif coordinates Mn2+ in GT6
confidence_limitations: High; the structure used for superposition here

claim_tested: DXD motif coordinates divalent metal in GT-A alpha-1,3-GalT
key_finding: Six WciN mutants identify a DXD metal-coordinating motif; divalent cations indispensable
confidence_limitations: Medium; bacterial GT, family-level support only

claim_tested: Loss of A3galt2 has a detectable organismal cost
key_finding: iGb3S-/- mice develop, grow and reproduce normally with normal iNKT numbers
confidence_limitations: High; shows the gene is dispensable even where it is active, so human LoF tolerance is not evidence of decay

claim_tested: Human A3GALT2 is expressed as spliced mRNA
key_finding: Spliced iGb3S mRNA not detected in human tissues
confidence_limitations: Medium; a regulatory claim, does not bear on coding integrity

claim_tested: A3GALT2 is constrained against LoF in humans
key_finding: LOEUF 1.32, pLI 6e-05, 14 obs vs 16.6 exp pLoF, missense Z -2.10
confidence_limitations: High for the metric; LOEUF ~1 is also normal for dispensable active enzymes

claim_tested: GT6 catalytic and donor positions are intact in human
key_finding: 14/16 audited positions identical in human and all 11 orthologs; 1 marmoset-specific Ile; 1 hominid Glu->Gly at 334
confidence_limitations: High for the alignment; transfer of bovine function to human is inference

claim_tested: No pseudogenisation signature in the coding locus
key_finding: CDS 1023 nt, 341 codons, ATG..TAG, 0 internal stops; 4/4 introns canonical GT..AG
omega 0.41 human-marmoset (Z -4.10) vs 0.40 macaque-marmoset (Z -4.06); A4GALT control 0.08-0.19
confidence_limitations: Medium-high; omega 0.4 is itself weak constraint, 5x the A4GALT value

claim_tested: The human donor site is geometrically assembled
key_finding: Human and rat models differ by <=0.35 A at all 20 measured ligand distances
confidence_limitations: Medium; apo predicted models, tests site assembly not turnover
